pipeline.selection: Same fixed recall, precision and improvement bounds, using symmetrical p^4 foreground and (1-p)^4 background confidence. Precision is inside-foreground / (inside-foreground + inside-background); recall is unchanged. Keep all existing local and observed-overlap gates. Reject unsupported alternatives; preserve existing weak crops as review-required. No fitting-error-based crop selection.
pipeline.fits: Reuse original production controls with unchanged source/geometry implementation; freshly fit every chosen neural crop. Both fixed cohorts include every unresolved or failed case. A body warning is separate from derived-mask agreement.
pipeline.validation: Independent exported weave error <=3%, original feature checks, geometry/paper checks, production editable conversion and independent editable-paper audit. Visual review of all photos/crops and distinct outputs.
pipeline.missing: No manual rescue or result-dependent replacement. Record photo eligibility misclassifications and possible irregular weaving separately without removing them from primary denominators.

scope: Fixed 32-photo regression and all 18 additional development photos; no training or runtime changes. Whole-body coverage tests a different crop policy. Preserve prior raw numerical failures and separately record physical-mask versus whole-photo success. The first whole-body policy loses a known good crop by counting uncertain foreground as certain background. This variant corrects that asymmetry with unchanged thresholds; it must be checked on both complete cohorts.
